title: Coefficient naturality of the target transition
statement: For scheme morphisms e:Y→T, h:Y→X, π:T′→T, a:Y′→Y, e′:Y′→T′ and h′:Y′→X with a≫e=e′≫π and a≫h=h′, every map α:F→G of étale Λ-module sheaves and every integer q satisfies B(e,h,q)(α)≫t(G)=t(F)≫B(e′,h′,q)(π*α), where B is baseChangeTargetFunctor and t is baseChangeTargetTransition [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions].

source.place: closed-open argument, lower-degree comparison / Leray edge

proof.text: Naturality of the derived adjunction unit and counit gives naturality of lowerStarPlusTransition. Compose this with the natural pullback-composition isomorphisms, the equality transport, and the single-complex comparison. Apply derived direct image and degree-q homology.

lemma target_transition_naturality
    {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (e : Y ⟶ T) (h : Y ⟶ X) (q : ℤ)
    {T' : Scheme.{u}} (π : T' ⟶ T) (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (e' : Y' ⟶ T') (h' : Y' ⟶ X)
    (wa : a ≫ e = e' ≫ π) (wh : a ≫ h = h')
    {F G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)} (α : F ⟶ G) :
    (baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ e h q).map α ≫
        baseChangeTargetTransition Λ e h q π a e' h' wa wh G =
      baseChangeTargetTransition Λ e h q π a e' h' wa wh F ≫
        (baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ e' h' q).map
          (((π)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map α)
